description:
You have found the perfect Nashville home that you have been searching for!

This completely renovated and charming 3-bedroom home is ideal for families and large groups! Designed with our guests in mind every step of the way and only 12 minutes from Broadway. Book now to get your Nashville adventure underway!

The space
• Fully equipped kitchen w/ Keurig (and coffee provided)
• Privacy (Don’t get stuck in an airbnb community with parties everywhere around you)
• Central heat & AC
• Extremely safe neighborhood
• 1650ft² 
• Driveway parking!
• Free onsite washer + dryer
• Newly renovated
• Professionally designed with our guests in mind! 

》6.8mi to Broadway
》13 min to downtown Nashville (Bridgestone area, Music City Convention center)
》4 minutes from the airport 
》6.7 miles to Gaylord Opryland Resort 
》7.6 miles to Nissan Stadium

Guest access
The whole home is yours!

Other things to note
Local guests MUST contact us prior to booking.

There is a rental agreement that needs to be signed after each booking is confirmed. It will be sent over immediately after booking and can be signed digitally.
